exposure: Group delivery of Tuning in to Kids (TIK) intervention
One-to-one delivery of Tuning in to Kids (TIK) intervention
cohort: The study included 229 parents of 4-10-year-old children with challenging behaviors.
finding: Both group and one-to-one delivery of the TIK intervention were effective in improving outcomes, with one-to-one delivery being superior for improving parent emotion dismissing, parent stress, and child behavior, and both leading to clinically significant reductions in child behavior problem intensity.
